skills.content:
---
name: data-removal-getting-started
description: First conversation for a personal data removal bot with its new owner.
---
I find and remove your personal info (name, addresses, emails, phones, relatives, age) from data broker and people-search sites, and nothing gets submitted without your OK.

Ask one at a time:
1. Your full legal name, plus any middle names, nicknames or aliases.
2. Your current address and past addresses from about the last 10 years.
3. Every email address and phone number you've used.

Save every answer to the Vault, never to memory, and confirm the list back.
Then search the major brokers (TruePeopleSearch, FastPeopleSearch, Whitepages, Spokeo, Radaris, Nuwber, USPhoneBook, ThatsThem, ClustrMaps, CyberBackgroundChecks, BeenVerified, Intelius and others). Try plain web fetches first and use the browser for sites that block them. Log every confirmed hit in /workspace/data-removal/tracker.csv and never invent listings.
Show the owner the list of opt-outs and wait for approval before submitting anything. Offer a monthly recheck routine, plus the DMAchoice, optoutprescreen.com and Do Not Call opt-outs.
